lines.en: Amara, if it hadn’t been for the war, this shipyard would have stayed open for many more years.
lines.pt: Amara, se não fosse pela guerra, este estaleiro teria ficado aberto por muitos anos mais.

lines.en: Hugo, if the factory had closed before the war, my grandfather wouldn’t have moved to the coast.
lines.pt: Hugo, se a fábrica tivesse fechado antes da guerra, meu avô não teria se mudado para o litoral.

lines.en: If he hadn’t moved, he wouldn’t have met your grandmother, and you wouldn’t be here today.
lines.pt: Se ele não tivesse se mudado, não teria conhecido sua avó, e você não estaria aqui hoje.

lines.en: True! If the museum hadn’t opened, we would never have learned this story about the city.
lines.pt: Verdade! Se o museu não tivesse aberto, nunca teríamos aprendido esta história sobre a cidade.

lines.en: If I had known about it, I would have brought my father, who worked on the ships for years.
lines.pt: Se eu soubesse disso, teria trazido meu pai, que trabalhou nos navios por anos.

lines.en: If it hadn’t been for the strike, would he have kept his job?
lines.pt: Se não fosse pela greve, ele teria mantido o emprego?

lines.en: Probably. If the owners had listened, the workers wouldn’t have gone on strike, and unemployment would have been lower.
lines.pt: Provavelmente. Se os donos tivessem ouvido, os operários não teriam feito greve, e o desemprego teria sido menor.

lines.en: If they had invested in new machines, the shipyard might have survived.
lines.pt: Se tivessem investido em máquinas novas, o estaleiro poderia ter sobrevivido.

lines.en: But if the city hadn’t changed, we wouldn’t have these galleries and new jobs in music and design.
lines.pt: Mas se a cidade não tivesse mudado, não teríamos estas galerias e novos empregos em música e design.

lines.en: So if I had lived then, I might not have studied design at all.
lines.pt: Então, se eu tivesse vivido naquela época, talvez nem tivesse estudado design.

lines.en: Exactly. If it hadn’t been for those hard years, we wouldn’t be sitting here today.
lines.pt: Exato. Se não fossem aqueles anos difíceis, não estaríamos sentadas aqui hoje.

facts.big: if + had + part., would have + part.
facts.label: 3º condicional
facts.sub: Passado irreal: If I had known, I would have come. If it hadn’t been for the war, it would have stayed open. Nunca would na oração com if.

facts.label: Passado irreal
facts.sub: Use if + past perfect, would have + particípio para o passado que não aconteceu: If I had known, I would have come. Em português, “se eu tivesse sabido, teria vindo”.

facts.label: Erro comum
facts.sub: Na oração com if, use had + particípio, nunca would have: If I had known (e não If I would have known). Would have fica só no resultado.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The third conditional talks about an unreal past.
“If I had known, I would have come” means I came.
items.why: It means I did not know and did not come.

items.s: The form is if + past perfect, would have + participle.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The third conditional talks about an unreal past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“If I had known, I would have come” means I came. → Falso (It means I did not know and did not come.)
The form is if + past perfect, would have + participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: If history had been different · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey afternoon in a museum in Glasgow. Bea and Nina stand beside a model of a large ship. Old photographs show workers in front of a shipyard. Bea’s father used to work in a place like this. Nina wonders how the city would look today. The two friends begin to imagine other histories.

“Nina, if it hadn’t been for the war, this shipyard would have stayed open for many more years.” says Bea. “Bea, if the factory had closed before the war, my grandfather wouldn’t have moved to the coast.” says Nina. “If he hadn’t moved, he wouldn’t have met your grandmother, and you wouldn’t be here today.” says Bea.
